description: JASDF free-loan airframe at 33.6746N 131.0123E; marked 81-5358 which is NOT its identity; previously displayed at Soeda Park

Flew in to Tsuiki from Hyakuri with 301 Sqn on 25 Jun 2020 and was struck off; moved by road to this site between 01:30 and 03:30 on 27 Jun 2021; installed at 33.6757N 131.0147E in the lawn park facing west to northwest
